illustrations.captionJa: 左から鶏肉・牛肉・豚肉の模式イラスト。実際の種類・部位は色だけで判断せず、納品表示と照合します。

translations.en: From left: chicken, beef and pork, shown schematically. Confirm the species and cut against delivery labels; appearance alone is insufficient.
translations.vi: Từ trái sang: thịt gà, thịt bò và thịt lợn, được minh họa khái quát. Không xác định loại thịt hoặc phần thịt chỉ bằng màu sắc; hãy đối chiếu nhãn giao hàng.
translations.id: Dari kiri: ayam, sapi, dan babi dalam ilustrasi sederhana. Pastikan jenis dan potongan daging melalui label pengiriman; jangan mengandalkan warna saja.
translations.zh-CN: 从左到右为鸡肉、牛肉和猪肉的示意图。肉类种类与部位应核对送货标签，不能仅凭颜色判断。
translations.zh-TW: 由左至右為雞肉、牛肉與豬肉的示意圖。肉類種類與部位應核對送貨標籤，不能僅憑顏色判斷。
translations.hi: बाएँ से: चिकन, गोमांस और सूअर के मांस का सांकेतिक चित्र। मांस का प्रकार और हिस्सा केवल रंग से न पहचानें; आपूर्ति के लेबल से मिलान करें।
translations.bn: বাম থেকে মুরগি, গরু ও শূকরের মাংসের ধারণামূলক ছবি। শুধু রং দেখে মাংসের ধরন বা অংশ নির্ধারণ করবেন না; সরবরাহের লেবেলের সঙ্গে মিলিয়ে নিন।
translations.ne: बायाँदेखि कुखुरा, गाई र सुँगुरको मासुको सांकेतिक चित्र। मासुको प्रकार र भाग रङबाट मात्र नछुट्याउनुहोस्; आपूर्तिको लेबलसँग मिलाउनुहोस्।
translations.my: ဘယ်မှညာသို့ ကြက်သား၊ အမဲသားနှင့် ဝက်သားတို့၏ သရုပ်ဖော်ပုံ ဖြစ်သည်။ အသားအမျိုးအစားနှင့် အစိတ်အပိုင်းကို အရောင်တစ်ခုတည်းဖြင့် မဆုံးဖြတ်ဘဲ ပစ္စည်းပို့ဆောင်မှုအညွှန်းနှင့် တိုက်စစ်ပါ။
translations.th: จากซ้ายคือภาพตัวอย่างเนื้อไก่ เนื้อวัว และเนื้อหมู อย่าตัดสินชนิดหรือส่วนของเนื้อจากสีเพียงอย่างเดียว ให้ตรวจเทียบกับฉลากสินค้าที่ส่งมา
translations.km: ពីឆ្វេងទៅស្តាំ គឺរូបគំនូរសាច់មាន់ សាច់គោ និងសាច់ជ្រូក។ កុំកំណត់ប្រភេទ ឬផ្នែកសាច់តាមពណ៌តែមួយមុខ ត្រូវផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់នឹងស្លាកទំនិញដែលបានដឹកមក។
translations.tl: Mula kaliwa: ilustrasyon ng manok, baka at baboy. Tiyakin ang uri at hiwa sa label ng mga inihatid na sangkap; huwag umasa sa kulay lamang.

illustrations.captionJa: 左から泡立て器・レードル・トング・ざる・中心温度計。形と用途を結び付け、実物の取扱説明書も確認します。

translations.en: From left: whisk, ladle, tongs, sieve and food probe thermometer. Match each shape to its purpose and check the actual equipment instructions.
translations.vi: Từ trái sang: phới đánh trứng, muôi, kẹp gắp, rây và nhiệt kế đo nhiệt độ tâm thực phẩm. Nhận biết hình dạng và công dụng, đồng thời kiểm tra hướng dẫn của dụng cụ thực tế.
translations.id: Dari kiri: pengocok, sendok sayur, penjepit, saringan, dan termometer tusuk makanan. Hubungkan bentuk dengan fungsinya dan periksa petunjuk alat yang digunakan.
translations.zh-CN: 从左到右：打蛋器、汤勺、食品夹、滤网和食品中心温度计。将形状与用途对应，并确认实际器具的使用说明。
translations.zh-TW: 由左至右：打蛋器、湯勺、食品夾、濾網及食品中心溫度計。將形狀與用途對應，並確認實際器具的使用說明。
translations.hi: बाएँ से: फेंटनी, करछी, चिमटा, छलनी और भोजन का अंदरूनी तापमान मापने वाला थर्मामीटर। आकार को उपयोग से जोड़ें और वास्तविक उपकरण के निर्देश भी जाँचें।
translations.bn: বাম থেকে: ফেটানি, হাতা, খাবার ধরার চিমটা, ছাঁকনি ও খাবারের ভেতরের তাপমাত্রা মাপার থার্মোমিটার। আকৃতির সঙ্গে ব্যবহার মিলিয়ে নিন এবং আসল যন্ত্রের নির্দেশিকাও দেখুন।
translations.ne: बायाँदेखि फेट्ने साधन, डाडु, खाना च्याप्ने चिम्टा, चाल्नी र खानाको भित्री तापक्रम नाप्ने थर्मोमिटर। आकार र प्रयोग जोडेर बुझ्नुहोस् र वास्तविक उपकरणको निर्देशन पनि हेर्नुहोस्।
translations.my: ဘယ်မှညာသို့ မွှေတံ၊ ဟင်းခပ်ဇွန်း၊ အစားအစာညှပ်၊ ဆန်ခါနှင့် အစားအစာအတွင်းပိုင်း အပူချိန်တိုင်းကိရိယာတို့ ဖြစ်သည်။ ပုံသဏ္ဌာန်နှင့် အသုံးပြုပုံကို ဆက်စပ်လေ့လာပြီး လက်တွေ့ကိရိယာ၏ အသုံးပြုလမ်းညွှန်ကိုလည်း စစ်ဆေးပါ။
translations.th: จากซ้ายคือ ตะกร้อมือ ทัพพี ที่คีบ กระชอน และเทอร์โมมิเตอร์วัดอุณหภูมิแกนกลางอาหาร เชื่อมโยงรูปร่างกับการใช้งาน และตรวจคู่มือของอุปกรณ์จริงด้วย
translations.km: ពីឆ្វេងទៅស្តាំ៖ ប្រដាប់វាយពង វែក ប្រដាប់ចាប់អាហារ តម្រង និងទែម៉ូម៉ែត្រវាស់សីតុណ្ហភាពខាងក្នុងអាហារ។ ភ្ជាប់រូបរាងនឹងមុខងារ ហើយពិនិត្យសៀវភៅណែនាំរបស់ឧបករណ៍ពិតផងដែរ។
translations.tl: Mula kaliwa: pambati, sandok, sipit, salaan at thermometer para sa loob ng pagkain. Iugnay ang hugis sa gamit at basahin din ang tagubilin ng aktuwal na kagamitan.

provenanceFindings: Both raster registrations declare original_imagegen, SHA256 and visualChecked true; domainReviewed and nativeReviewed remain false. Audit did not view raster pixels or validate hashes because registered asset paths are absent in this checkout.

Both rasters have Japanese captions and 12 translated caption locales. Captions explicitly limit recognition by color and defer to actual labels/instructions. Translation presence is not linguistic approval.
Four diagrams provide conceptual coverage: separation, core temperature, allergy response, corrective action. They do not cover missing object recognition categories.
Knowledge ledger has 277 illustration-needed units; these overlap concept/subsection/chapter records and must not be interpreted as 277 distinct images.

assetResolutionGap.action: Root should locate packaged/hosted assets and verify runtime URL resolution plus SHA256 before claiming available visual assets.

prioritizedBriefs.brief: Original lateral whole-fish illustration with clear eye, dorsal fin, lateral line, gill cover, collar, pectoral/pelvic/anal fins. No embedded lettering; add vetted labels in UI.
Consistent-scale side-by-side source-named cuts using one carrot or daikon; neutral background; shape recognition only, no unsafe knife demonstration.
Original whole fish beside dressed fish, two fillets and central skeleton, with separable views of source-named processed forms; no procedural hand poses.
Separate clear silhouettes of source-listed knife types, frying pan, stockpot and storage containers; isolated objects with caption labels outside raster.
Separate cards showing source-listed oven, steamer, fryer, refrigerator and freezer; washing equipment belongs in adjacent lesson 13; no brand logos.

Original beef pork chicken body-region comparison; distinct silhouettes and source-verified region callouts outside raster. Existing tray image identifies species only and does not show anatomical cuts.
Source-listed representative leafy, root and fruit vegetables plus fruit as isolated specimens; seasonality must be qualified in prose rather than inferred from images.
Original attendant carrying balanced tray with clean food-contact boundaries, unobstructed sightline and clear hand placement; reviewed against source lesson.
Precise top-down Japanese meal setting composed with SVG or HTML; original raster tableware optional. Exact arrangement should be source checked and locale captions external.

coverageLimits: Existing meat trays omit body cut recognition; existing tools cover only whisk ladle tongs sieve probe thermometer, omitting many source-listed tools.
No raster illustration attachment exists for fish, vegetables, cut shapes, fish processing, major equipment or service handling.
Audit is based on repository registrations, lesson titles and source-heading ledger; original source PDF details need checking before final visual labels or instructional claims.
integrationFollowup: See closure-status.json and closure-source-links.json for changes after this baseline audit.
correction: Initial inventory omitted16cutting cards and mistook sparse local absence for missing assets. Superseded by closure-illustration-audit-supplement.json for those findings.
